# Ordinance No. 10, Series of 1997

**Ordinance Limiting the Area of Fish Pens**

## Summary

This ordinance limits the area of fish pens in Pitogo, Quezon to a maximum of 400 square meters. It also sets corresponding fees for business permits and mayor's permits, as well as penalties for violations. The ordinance aims to regulate fish pen operations and ensure compliance with local regulations.

## Key Provisions

1.  Section 1. All fish pens shall have an area of not more than 400 square meters.
2.  Section 2. Fish pens shall be located where they shall not hinder the free flow of navigation and should be provided with visible lighting system.
3.  Section 3. A permit shall be issued only upon the recommendation of the Municipal Agriculturist and the Barangay Captain on whose jurisdiction the fish pen is to be located.
4.  Section 4. Only one permit shall be issued to an individual, corporation, or cooperative. Persons related to the third degree by consanguinity and affinity shall be entitled to only one permit.
5.  Section 5. A business permit of ₱8.00 per square meter and a mayor's permit of ₱4.00 per square meter shall be charged each application. The permit shall only be good for one (1) calendar year and shall be renewable every year.
6.  Section 6. Violators shall be fined ₱2,500.00 per violation.
7.  Section 7. All ordinances inconsistent with this ordinance shall be repealed.
8.  Section 8. This ordinance shall take effect ten (10) days after approval.
